units.source_text: “当然能分辨出来，还不到二十人嘛。

en.t: Of course I can tell them apart; there are fewer than twenty of them.

units.source_text: 弹《都都逸》［《都都逸》，又名《都都一》，流行的爱情民歌］

en.t: When they play dodoitsu, a popular love folk song also called dodoichi,

units.source_text: 就更好分辨了，因为它最能表现出每个人的风格来。”

en.t: it is even easier to tell them apart, because it brings out each person's individual style most clearly.
